body:
## What this ticket includes

This WeGoTrip listing is an admission ticket for the Grand Palace in Bangkok, the former royal residence on Rattanakosin Island. When we read the page on 11 November 2026 it named four inclusions: entry to the Grand Palace itself, entry to Wat Phra Kaew (the temple of the Emerald Buddha inside the palace walls), entry to the Queen Sirikit Museum of Textiles, and a seat at a Khon masked-dance performance at the Sala Chalermkrung Royal Theater. Food and drinks are listed as not included.

The page's booking data showed a single price category, a **Regular ticket for ages 4 to 99 at €22.54**. The product carried a rating of 3.1 out of 5 from 12 ratings and 5 written reviews, which is a small sample and lower than many attraction tickets on the same platform.

## How entry works

The ticket is split across two documents, and the listing is explicit about this. WeGoTrip issues a smartphone voucher, and the local operator sends each visitor their own QR code in a separate email. You show the voucher together with the QR code at the counter and then go straight in; there is no paper ticket to exchange. Check your inbox (and spam folder) for the operator's email after booking, because without the per-person QR code the voucher alone is not enough.

The ticket stays valid for **seven days from the date printed on the voucher**, which gives some slack if a day of heavy rain or a royal ceremony changes your plans.

## The Khon performance

The Khon show is the part of this ticket most people overlook. According to the listing it runs **Monday to Friday only**, with three shows a day at 1:00 PM, 2:30 PM and 5:30 PM, each lasting 25 minutes. If you visit the palace at the weekend, you will not be able to use that part of the ticket on the same day, so plan a weekday if the show matters to you.

## What to check before booking

- **Dress code:** the listing asks for proper clothing, with no shorts and no sleeveless shirts. Shoulders and knees should be covered.
- **Children:** children under 120 cm enter free, and children must show their passports at the entrance. Bring them even for young kids.
- **Queues:** the description talks about fast-track entry, but the page's ticket data does not mark the product as skip-the-line. Treat it as a standard entry ticket.
- **Cancellation:** the product page does not state a cancellation window and refers to WeGoTrip's general conditions. Read the terms at checkout before you pay.
- **What to bring:** the listing suggests bottled water, snacks and comfortable shoes. The palace grounds are large and mostly unshaded.
